زُمَلِقٌ and ↓ زُمَّلِقٌ and ↓ زُمَالِقٌ are expl. in the S in art. زلق [q. v., voce زَلِقٌ]: in the K, in the present art., agreeably with the opinion of Aboo- 'Obeyd. (TA.) [The first is said in the TA, voce ثَتٌّ, to be syn. with عِذْيَوْطٌ, q. v.] ―
-b2- The first is also applied to an ass, as meaning Fat; whose back is even by reason of the fat. (Lh, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
